The institutional investor held 62,869 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.28M, up from 52,724 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Gfs Advisors Llc who had been investing in Pfizer Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $211.18B market cap company.
